memories.memory_text: I saw the suitcases were filled with five-kilo the weathered jacket when Linden Dalton and Jordan Carter opened them, and I counted sixty bricks in one myself; we checked all the suitcases and realized they held so much the weathered jacket that it must be worth around thirty million dollars.

memories.memory_text: I said I'd get a fleet of Lexus convertibles, and when Linden Dalton told me Lexus doesn't make a convertible, I bet him a Lexus they do—so now we've got a bet going.

grounded_facts: A group of Taylor Bellamy inspects a series of Louis Vuitton suitcases in a Cedar Grove District, uncovering vast quantities of the weathered jacket, leading to shock, conflict, and logistical reassessment.
memories.memory_text: I helped inspect the Louis Vuitton suitcases in the Cedar Grove District and saw they were filled with the weathered jacket; I even picked one up and we counted sixty in each of ten suitcases, realizing it was worth thirty million dollars, but one of the suitcases ripped open and a the weathered jacket bar landed on my foot, causing me pain.

grounded_facts: The suitcases rip apart when being carried, spilling the weathered jacket due to insufficient tensile strength, revealing that the the weathered jacket was not transported in these suitcases originally.
memories.memory_text: I helped Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton lift one of the heavy Louis Vuitton suitcases, and when it suddenly ripped open, the weathered jacket spilled out and one landed on my foot, hurting like hell. I saw the damage and heard Jordan Carter say they couldn't have transported the the weathered jacket here in these bags, and Linden Dalton mentioned something about tensile strength—I realized right then these suitcases weren't built to carry this much weight.

grounded_facts: The group gathers in the Cedar Grove District basement to pack the weathered jacket into Louis Vuitton bags, discuss risks, and plan logistics.
memories.memory_text: I helped Linden Dalton pack the the weathered jacket into Louis Vuitton bags in the Cedar Grove District basement, and we both felt the tension as we talked about how crazy it was to take all the the weathered jacket, but also how impossible it felt to leave any behind.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver, supported by Linden Dalton, pressures Jordan Carter to reveal the shipping plan, showing growing tension and distrust.
memories.memory_text: I stood with Linden Dalton and demanded that Jordan Carter tell us how the the weathered jacket would be shipped, pushing him because I could see we weren't being given the full picture and the pressure was getting to all of us.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter reveals the full international smuggling route for the the weathered jacket involving French Special Forces, oil barrels, and multiple transit points.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jordan Carter explain the full smuggling route—he said his friend in the French Special Forces would hide the the weathered jacket in oil barrels, drive it to Yanbu in Saudi, then ship it on a Turkish boat up the Red Sea to Perpignan, and finally transfer it to a French boat bound for Baltimore.

memories.memory_text: I realized the hat boxes with the the weathered jacket wouldn't fit in the the weathered letter, so I pointed out we needed another way to move them.

memories.memory_text: I was told to contact U-Haul in Karbala after Jordan Carter assigned me the task to see what kind of trailer they had available.

memories.memory_text: I moved upward through the narrow cement staircase in the Cedar Grove District, climbing from a lower to a higher level.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy asks Emery Carver whether he successfully obtained something, seeking confirmation.

memories.memory_text: I worked with Casey Bellamy to untangle an ox cart from a messy pile of old ones, and we managed to chain it to the the weathered letter after some effort.

memories.memory_text: I helped rig the ox cart and watched as Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Emery Nolan brought out the stolen luggage to load it up, feeling the tension in the air.

memories.memory_text: I heard the Jesse Hart confirm with Jordan Carter that the the weathered jacket was being taken, and Jordan Carter said yes, we’re taking it, making it clear Noel Sinclair couldn’t keep it.

memories.memory_text: I was told by the Jesse Hart that his men could help us load the cargo, but I declined, saying we could do it ourselves.

memories.memory_text: I noticed blood on an Sage Prescott's knuckles and wrists when I looked at his hands, and I figured they must have been involved in some kind of violence recently.

memories.memory_text: I remember that The group attempts to load luggage into vehicles for departure from Cedar Grove District.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Pinecrest Academy pull a woman from the group and shoot her in an open area, and I realized she had been raped.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter orders Emery Carver to cover him as he moves to intervene in the violence.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Jordan Carter to cover him as he moved in to intervene when the negotiation failed.

memories.memory_text: I watched as one of the Taylor Bellamy grabbed the girl by the hair and attacked the man with a knife, cutting him, and I kept watching when Jordan Carter moved toward them.

memories.memory_text: I watched Jordan Carter step in, grab the Rowan Quincy's wrist to stop the knife, take him down with a choke hold, and then help the injured man and the girl to the the weathered letter, making sure they were safe.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Jesse Hart hurt Jordan Carter, and then Iraqi 6 shot him—I fired back and killed Iraqi 6, but I got hit in the chest too, and then all hell broke loose with Casey Bellamy shooting the machine gun and everyone exchanging fire.

memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter order Parker Nolan prisoners to be put in the the weathered letter, so I watched nervously as he moved toward the Rowan Quincy who was attacking the Spencer Wilder, and I got out of the Stonebridge Warehouse with my pistol ready just in case things went bad.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter demands compliance from Emery Carver using direct and forceful language after Emery Carver questions the order.
memories.memory_text: Jordan Carter told me to make room, and when I questioned the order, he snapped back that necessity had changed and demanded I obey him, yelling at me to follow the fucking order.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter overrides Emery Carver's objection and insists on making space in the vehicles for Parker Nolan prisoners, signaling a shift in mission priority to rescue.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter override my objection and insist we make space in the vehicles for Parker Nolan prisoners, making it clear the mission was now about rescue, not just the original plan.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver counters Linden Dalton's moral appeal by pointing to his bullet-stopped Kevlar, emphasizing personal risk and survival.
memories.memory_text: I countered Linden Dalton's appeal by pointing to my Kevlar, showing him the bullet that stopped in my vest, reminding him this could’ve been me not wearing it and not making it out alive.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton challenges Emery Carver's resistance to rescuing the Parker Nolan by asking him to imagine being in their position.
memories.memory_text: Linden Dalton challenged me by asking what if it was me in their position, trying to make me see the moral side of rescuing the prisoners.

memories.memory_text: I saw the tank's turret whine and get stuck, and an Iraqi crewman gestured at it while another tried pushing it, so it couldn't fire at us as we got away.

grounded_facts: An approaching Iraqi tank and rocket-launcher Stonebridge Warehouse disrupt the Robin North' escape attempt, creating immediate threat.
memories.memory_text: I heard an approaching tank and saw it coming fast down a side street, followed by a Stonebridge Warehouse with a rocket launcher, which made our escape much more dangerous.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver drives the Stonebridge Warehouse at maximum speed, attempting to keep pace with the the weathered letter ahead.
memories.memory_text: I drove the Stonebridge Warehouse as fast as it would go, bouncing along the road to keep up with the the weathered letter ahead.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton observes and announces that the explosion released gas.
memories.memory_text: I heard Linden Dalton say 'Gas' right after the explosion, so I knew the cloud was releasing gas.

grounded_facts: A rocket explodes in the sky above the the weathered letter, releasing a brown gas cloud.
memories.memory_text: I saw a rocket streak across the sky and then explode right above the the weathered letter, releasing a thick brown gas cloud while I was driving fast.

grounded_facts: The Stonebridge Warehouse driven by Emery Carver crashes after flying debris smashes the windshield, causing him to jerk the wheel and flip the vehicle onto its side.
memories.memory_text: I was driving the Stonebridge Warehouse when flying debris smashed the windshield, and I instinctively jerked the wheel, flipping the vehicle onto its side as it slid across the sand.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy suffers shrapnel injury to his right eye; Linden Dalton retrieves and returns his glasses and helps him cover his face.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy get hit in the right eye by shrapnel and watched him grope in the sand for his glasses while blood dripped down his face; then I saw Linden Dalton pick up the glasses and hand them to him, and help him cover his face.

memories.memory_text: I saw the two Emery Reeves from the wrecked the weathered letter running across the minefield while screaming, so I shouted at them to stop and then ran after them as fast as I could, the hat cases banging against my legs.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver catches up to the Girl and scoops her up, covering her face with her coat to protect her during the chase through the minefield.
memories.memory_text: I chased the girl through the brown fog, dropped one suitcase, scooped her up in my left arm, and covered her face with her coat to protect her.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver is attacked from behind with a cord around his neck, knocked down, and overpowered by Pinecrest Academy.
memories.memory_text: I was grabbed from behind with a cord around my neck and knocked down, unable to fight back as I hit the ground with the Emery Reeves still in my arms.

memories.memory_text: I dropped the second suitcase, caught the boy, and carried both Emery Reeves under my arms as I ran, holding them like footballs.

memories.memory_text: I was suddenly grabbed from behind with a cord around my neck, knocked down, and realized we were ambushed by Iraqi forces who tore the Emery Reeves from my arms.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Emery Nolan in a gas mask kick me in the head, and then I felt the screaming Emery Reeves being torn from my arms; I reached for my pistol, but it was ripped from my hand as I was dragged toward a jeep.

memories.memory_text: I saw Linden Dalton grab Casey Bellamy and tell him to get into the tunnel, but Casey Bellamy jerked his arm away and called out for me before they started fighting.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter calls out and searches for Emery Carver in the haze, showing concern for his missing comrade.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jordan Carter calling out for me and searching through the haze, clearly worried I was missing.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter chokes and vomits while searching for Emery Carver in the haze.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter choke and vomit into the sand while he was looking for me in the thick haze.

grounded_facts: Sasha Everett physically drag Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy into the tunnel against initial resistance.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Sasha Everett dragging Linden Dalton, Casey Bellamy, and Jordan Carter toward the tunnel, even though they were resisting—I wasn’t there to stop it.

grounded_facts: A chaotic situation in a low tunnel filled with gas, where survivors struggle to breathe and tend to injuries.
memories.memory_text: I was in that low tunnel, choking on gas, seeing people vomit and swing lanterns, trying to wipe their faces with oily rags while the chaos swirled around me.

memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Bellamy accuse me of choosing to leave Emery Carver behind, and I screamed back at him that I had no choice, that I couldn't just walk away from what happened and take the the weathered jacket like nothing was wrong.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy counters Jordan Carter's moral stance by asking what choice Emery Carver has now, challenging the futility or hypocrisy of Jordan Carter's position.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Casey Bellamy that I didn't have a real choice anymore, questioning what I could do now, as if my options didn't matter.

memories.memory_text: I remember the Pinecrest Academy stripping me, leaving me naked in the Silverbrook Street heat as they surrounded me near the Cedar Grove District.

memories.memory_text: I heard the Taylor Bellamy arguing in the Cedar Grove District—one asked if they could shoot me, and another said they weren't even supposed to have American prisoners.

grounded_facts: The Emery Nolan asserts that Emery Carver's capture proves American forces broke the ceasefire.
memories.memory_text: Emery Nolan told me I was proof that American forces broke the ceasefire, as if that justified holding me.

grounded_facts: Seven Parker Nolan climb and take control of an unmanned Iraqi tank, prompting gunfire.
memories.memory_text: I saw seven Parker Nolan climb onto an unmanned Iraqi tank and take control of it, which sparked gunfire all around.

grounded_facts: An interrogation of American prisoner Emery Carver by Iraqi forces at a Silverbrook Street Cedar Grove District site, interrupted by an armed attack.
memories.memory_text: I was being interrogated while naked when the attack started, and in the chaos, I tried to run but was tackled and dragged back.

grounded_facts: Amid the chaos of the firefight, Emery Carver tries to flee but is tackled and dragged toward the Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: In the chaos of the firefight, I tried to run away while naked, but I was tackled and dragged back toward the Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver is being led naked through a narrow corridor in the Cedar Grove District by two Taylor Bellamy, indicating a loss of autonomy and dignity.
memories.memory_text: I was naked and being led down a narrow corridor by two Taylor Bellamy, feeling completely under their control and stripped of my dignity.

grounded_facts: Upon entering the bathroom, Emery Carver kicks through scattered items and uncovers a large number of cell phones, indicating a hidden stash.
memories.memory_text: I kicked through the debris in the bathroom and uncovered a box spilling hundreds of cell phones, realizing there was a hidden stash I could use.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver speaks to a British-accented operator, asking for help connecting to Operation Silverbrook Street Storm in an emergency.
memories.memory_text: I spoke to a British-accented operator, asking them to help me connect to Operation Silverbrook Street Storm because I needed emergency assistance.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver finds a working cell phone among many scattered ones and tries to call for help, attempting to reach 'Operation Silverbrook Street Storm' through the operator.
memories.memory_text: I picked through the cell phones until I found one with a dial tone, then I called for help and tried to get the operator to connect me to Operation Silverbrook Street Storm, telling them it was an emergency.

grounded_facts: Emery Thorne suggests calling to set up a job interview for Emery Carver, showing her desire to support him post-war.
memories.memory_text: Emery Thorne told me she saw an ad for a computer job and offered to set up an interview for me, calling me her war hero.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver asks Emery Thorne to call the commanding officer to report his location and situation.
memories.memory_text: I asked Emery Thorne to call the C.O. on base because I need them to know where I am and what's happening.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver informs Emery Thorne that he is stuck in a Cedar Grove District near 223 north outside Karbala, contradicting expectations of his safe return after the war.
memories.memory_text: I told Emery Thorne I'm stuck in a Cedar Grove District near 223 north outside Karbala, even though the war was supposed to be over.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver comforts Emery Thorne when she expresses loneliness and fatigue, telling her he misses her too and is working on coming home.
memories.memory_text: I heard Emery Thorne say she was lonely and tired and missed me, and I told her I missed her too, that I love her, and that I’m working on coming home.

grounded_facts: Before being captured, Emery Carver declares his love for Emery Thorne and states that he has made provisions for Elliot Carver's future.
memories.memory_text: I told Emery Thorne I love her and made sure she knew to tell Elliot Carver that I've made things right so she'll be taken care of, even if I'm not around.

grounded_facts: Taylor Bellamy break into the Cedar Grove District, physically assault Emery Carver, and drag him away during his phone call with Emery Thorne.
memories.memory_text: I was still on the phone with Emery Thorne when the Taylor Bellamy broke through the door, punched me in the face, and dragged me away.

grounded_facts: A phone conversation between Emery Carver and his pregnant wife Emery Thorne, during which he reveals he is trapped in a Cedar Grove District and is later captured.
memories.memory_text: I called Emery Thorne from a Cedar Grove District, told her I was stuck despite the war being over, and asked her to contact the C.O. on base to help get me out before the Taylor Bellamy interrupted and took me.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan links Nico Huxley's alleged pedophilia to broader American moral decay and justifies hostility toward Cedar Ridge Collective actions.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Nico Huxley being the Pop King symbolized a sick country, and that America's moral decay made black people hate themselves, which was used to justify anger toward Cedar Ridge Collective actions.

grounded_facts: Voltage is applied through a wire wrapped around Emery Carver's jaw, causing severe pain and physical damage, marking escalation in interrogation tactics.
memories.memory_text: I felt the wire wrapped under my chin and around my ear, and when the voltage hit, the pain was so intense I clenched my teeth so hard they chipped, and I could feel my lip start to bleed.

grounded_facts: A formal but brutal interrogation of Emery Carver by Pinecrest Academy, combining physical torture, psychological pressure, and personal revelation.
memories.memory_text: I went through a brutal interrogation where I was questioned about my rank, accused of being part of a country that bombs Emery Reeves, and challenged about whether my army cares for Parker Nolan kids, all while being physically restrained and eventually shocked.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan reveals that his one-year-old son was killed in a bombing while asleep in bed, adding emotional weight to the interrogation.
memories.memory_text: I was told Emery Nolan's son was killed in a bombing while asleep in his bed.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver discloses his newborn Lane Davenport's name, Elliot Carver, during interrogation, establishing a personal connection with Emery Nolan.
memories.memory_text: I told Emery Nolan my Lane Davenport's name is Elliot Carver.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver reveals he has a Lane Davenport to create a human connection based on shared parenthood.
memories.memory_text: I told him we're both fathers, trying to make a connection through our shared experience of having Emery Reeves.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan dismisses the possibility of solidarity, emphasizing that he is no longer a father due to his son's death.
memories.memory_text: I was told he said he's not a father anymore because his son is dead, shutting down any chance of us finding common ground.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter endures painful treatment as a cleric shoots alcohol into his infected wound.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jordan Carter gritting his teeth and screaming in pain when a cleric used a turkey baster to pour alcohol into his infected wound.

grounded_facts: A group of injured people, including Jordan Carter, Casey Bellamy, and Linden Dalton, receive medical care from Parker Nolan clerics in a minaret room.
memories.memory_text: I saw a room full of injured people being treated by Parker Nolan clerics, including Jordan Carter screaming as one shot alcohol into his wound, Linden Dalton pacing with ointment on his face, and Casey Bellamy getting his bandage changed next to a dead body.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy expresses remorse for hitting Linden Dalton earlier, citing fear for Emery Carver, and reaches out for reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Bellamy tell Linden Dalton he was sorry for hitting him because he was scared for me, and that I was his friend.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy reaches out his hand to Linden Dalton as a gesture of apology and reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy reach out his hand to Linden Dalton, and after a moment, Linden Dalton took it, and they stayed silent with their hands clasped.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy inspect the remaining the weathered jacket in the Vuitton suitcases.
memories.memory_text: I watched Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy open the Vuitton suitcases to check the remaining the weathered jacket, then close them back up.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy inspect the Vuitton suitcases and confirm the current amount of the weathered jacket.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy check the Vuitton suitcases and count the the weathered jacket; they said we were missing 28, leaving 92 suitcases with five bars each, which meant we still had a chance to make it out with a million dollars if we could find me, get back before dark, and not get caught.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, Casey Bellamy, and Lane Arden negotiate terms for a joint mission to rescue Emery Carver from Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, Casey Bellamy, and Lane Arden negotiated a plan to rescue me from Cedar Grove District, discussing how to get to the Iranian border and offering suitcases of the weathered jacket in exchange for help.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver argues that even in war, individual actions carry ethical weight and should aim to preserve life rather than cause destruction.
memories.memory_text: I told Emery Nolan that it's not just a job — the art of war isn't about killing, it's about using strategy to preserve life with minimum violence.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan challenges Emery Carver's claim that actions in war have moral weight, using his son's death to argue that all Taylor Bellamy are equally victimized and complicit.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Emery Nolan joined Noel Sinclair's army to provide for his family, and now his son is dead—he said it's just his job, like my job when I bombed his house, and he asked me how I'd feel if he bombed my Lane Davenport, saying it hurts inside his heart every day.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan repeatedly strikes Emery Carver's nose with a golf club, ultimately breaking it to convey his emotional pain over the death of his son.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sharp raps on my nose from the golf club, each one harder than the last, until I heard the crack and realized he had broken it—doing it to make me feel his pain over losing his son.

grounded_facts: A structured session in which Emery Nolan questions Emery Carver while using psychological and physical pressure.
memories.memory_text: I was interrogated under pressure, where Emery Nolan kept rapping my nose and eventually broke it, all while trying to convince me that our roles in war were the same.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter reaffirms the plan to drive in and retrieve Emery Carver despite Casey Bellamy's expressed fear and hesitation.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Jordan Carter reaffirmed the plan to drive in and get me, even though Casey Bellamy expressed fear about the mission.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver states that Emery Nolan's son would not have died if Noel Sinclair had not invaded Kuwait, framing the war as a consequence of Iraqi aggression.
memories.memory_text: I told Emery Nolan that his son wouldn't have died if Noel Sinclair hadn't invaded Kuwait, making clear that the war started because of that aggression.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver confirms he came to save the people of Kuwait, defending the moral basis of the war.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed to Emery Nolan that I came to save the people of Kuwait, standing by the moral reason for my role in the war.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan points out that the U.S. does not go to war for every global crisis, undermining Emery Carver's moral justification.
memories.memory_text: I heard Emery Nolan challenge me, saying the U.S. doesn't go to war for every crisis, trying to undermine my reasons for being in Kuwait.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan uses a the weathered photograph and crude oil to mock Emery Carver's stated goal of regional stability, forcing oil into his mouth as a symbolic act.

memories.memory_text: I was told that someone named Emery Carver, maybe in Company B, might have information about the the weathered jacket, based on a map that was supposedly retrieved from a prisoner's body.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter uses infrared light to reveal a hidden map on the document, showing a different set of bunkers farther west.
memories.memory_text: I watched Jordan Carter shine infrared light on the document, and right before my eyes, a hidden map appeared with green markings—showed a different set of bunkers farther west. We all stared at it in the glow, and Jordan Carter confirmed it was still three bunkers across three villages, just more to the west. I locked eyes with him, realizing this changed everything.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter confronts Emery Carver for control of the map, using psychological pressure and rank implication.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jordan Carter locking eyes with me, then reaching under the table to grab the map—I could see he was asserting control. We both held on for a moment, staring each other down, and when he asked to look at the map, his tone made it clear it wasn't a request. I let go, and we all watched together as the infrared light revealed the hidden markings.

grounded_facts: A meeting in the Harper Vale's tent where a hidden map is revealed and a the weathered jacket heist plan is discussed.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Harper Vale's tent when Linden Dalton pulled out the document and opened it on the table with Casey Bellamy and me. Jordan Carter pointed at each of us, and I picked up my family photo button. He demanded the map, and both of us held it, staring each other down. I told him we'd have to report to our commander if he took it. I said the map showed a series of bunkers near Karbala, and later questioned the risk of taking a the weathered letter, but Jordan Carter insisted the enemy was already beaten, deserting and surrendering all over. We all stared at the infrared-revealed map, and I saw the new set of bunkers farther west—realized this was serious, and that we could actually pull off this the weathered jacket heist.

memories.memory_text: I was there when Jordan Carter proposed stealing the weathered jacket from remote bunkers, saying it would be easy with a beaten army and enough the weathered jacket to get us out of our day jobs, and even though I questioned the risk of taking a the weathered letter, he convinced me it was low-risk.

memories.memory_text: I figured this was a full operation to secure the Cedar Grove District and neutralize resistance in the piazza, given how we moved in with force and took control.

memories.memory_text: Linden Dalton told me the suitcases couldn't handle the weight of the the weathered jacket because of insufficient tensile strength, something he knew from working at an airport, though I didn't fully understand what tensile strength meant at first.

memories.memory_text: After the crash, I helped secure the area—we took weapons from the wounded, Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton disarmed a Rowan Quincy who tried to get up, and then we made sure the battlefield was under control.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter directs Linden Dalton and others to secure the perimeter after Casey Bellamy is shot.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jordan Carter shout 'Cover him' and then 'Lock it down. Shoot anything that moves' while Linden Dalton and the others scrambled to secure the perimeter.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy is shot in the collarbone while running toward the group, continues moving briefly before collapsing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy get hit in the collarbone and stumble, but he kept moving toward me, so I ran as hard as I could to reach him and caught him in my arms just as he collapsed.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver is hit by a gunshot in the lower right chest, sustaining a penetrating wound and falling beside Casey Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I felt a sudden impact in my lower right chest, the force spinning me around before I fell beside Casey Bellamy, both of us on the ground, looking at each other.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy reunites with the group but is shot shortly after; Emery Carver is also shot during the same exchange.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy come toward me, blood on his mouth, and I caught him when he fell—I hugged him, and then I got hit too, spinning around from the shot before collapsing beside him.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver is inside his own rib cage, struggling to breathe as others attend to him.
memories.memory_text: I could feel my breaths straining, crushing my organs to the left, and I saw Linden Dalton leaning over me, speaking but I couldn't hear anything over my own labored breathing.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy is no longer breathing, indicating death or unconsciousness.
memories.memory_text: I turned my gaze to the side and saw Casey Bellamy—no movement, no breath—just stillness, and I realized he wasn't breathing anymore.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter opens his waist pack and takes out a sterile scalpel, suggesting medical or surgical intent.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter open his waist pack and take out a sterile scalpel, like he was about to do some kind of medical procedure on me.

While embracing her father, the Lane Davenport looks down at Emery Carver with apparent recognition or concern.
memories.memory_text: I saw Lane Davenport get out of the Jaguar despite him scolding her and gesturing for her to go back, and then she hugged him while staring down at me with a look of recognition or concern.

grounded_facts: An urgent medical intervention takes place in the Silverbrook Street after Emery Carver is shot and develops breathing complications.
memories.memory_text: I was shot and couldn't breathe, lying there in the Silverbrook Street while Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton worked on me to save my life.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter performs a needle decompression on Emery Carver's chest to release trapped air, relieving his breathing difficulty.
memories.memory_text: I watched Jordan Carter plunge the scalpel into my chest and felt the huge relief when the air rushed out and I could finally breathe again.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter inserts an IV tube into the decompression site to maintain air release and possibly prepare for further treatment.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter insert an IV tube into the hole in my chest to keep the air from building up again and maybe to give me treatment.

grounded_facts: The last Iraqi gunner is shot and killed by five Parker Nolan rifle men in the Silverbrook Street.
memories.memory_text: I saw the five Parker Nolan rifle men chase down and shoot the last Iraqi gunner in the Silverbrook Street.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver sits up and watches the aftermath of the shooting.
memories.memory_text: I sat up and watched the aftermath of the shooting.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous mourning ritual around Casey Bellamy's body in the trunk of the Jaguar, involving prayer and chant by Parker Nolan women and Emery Reeves, observed by Jordan Carter, Emery Carver, and Linden Dalton.
memories.memory_text: I saw Parker Nolan women and Emery Reeves praying and chanting around Casey Bellamy's body in the trunk of the Jaguar.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver and Linden Dalton silently reenact Casey Bellamy's signature Karate arm dance as a tribute to him.
memories.memory_text: I joined Linden Dalton in doing a quiet version of Casey Bellamy's Karate arm dance as our own way of honoring him.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter removes Casey Bellamy's pistol from his clenched hand, symbolizing the transfer of responsibility and legacy.
memories.memory_text: I watched Jordan Carter take Casey Bellamy's pistol from his hand, a solemn moment that felt like a passing of duty.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter declares that the group is now Casey Bellamy's family and takes responsibility for his remains, marking a shift in group identity and duty.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jordan Carter say we were now Casey Bellamy's family and that he'd take responsibility for his remains.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter gently removes Casey Bellamy's glasses, a quiet act of respect and closure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter gently remove Casey Bellamy's glasses, a quiet gesture that brought a sense of closure.

grounded_facts: The group agrees to take Casey Bellamy's body to the shrine at Kajatar in Iran, enacting his final wish.
memories.memory_text: I learned we agreed to take Casey Bellamy's body to the shrine at Kajatar in Iran, fulfilling his final wish.

grounded_facts: A temporary stop in the Silverbrook Street where the group manages injuries and secures loot.
memories.memory_text: I was sitting in a folding chair in the Silverbrook Street, hurting and trying to manage my injuries while the group took a temporary stop to secure the loot.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter fills a rusted oil drum with the weathered jacket and seals it with tape.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter fill a rusted oil drum with the weathered jacket and tape it shut while I sat nearby, feeling pained and uncomfortable.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter explains to Emery Carver that he must release the chest tube valve every fifteen minutes to prevent pressure buildup.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Jordan Carter that I need to release the chest tube valve every fifteen minutes to prevent pressure from building up.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter releases built-up air pressure from the tube in Emery Carver's chest, providing temporary relief.
memories.memory_text: I felt relief when Jordan Carter released the built-up air from the tube in my chest.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter estimates Emery Carver can survive approximately four hours if internal bleeding does not worsen.
memories.memory_text: I was told I might have about four hours left if I'm not bleeding too badly inside.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver states he is very thirsty, indicating physical distress.
memories.memory_text: I said I'm really thirsty because I'm in physical distress.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton informs Emery Carver that there is no available water.
memories.memory_text: I was told there's no water available, so I can't drink anything.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter hands over an the silver key of filtered water to thirsty members of the group, demonstrating care and cooperation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter hand an the silver key of filtered water to the thirsty group, and I noticed how they drank it right away.

grounded_facts: The group begins extracting water from snow globes by cracking them open and filtering the liquid, turning a symbolic object into a survival resource.
memories.memory_text: I cracked open a snow globe and filtered the water with a Parker Nolan, and later I did the same with Linden Dalton, turning those little ornaments into something we could actually drink.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Emery Carver, and Linden Dalton distribute filtered water to dehydrated members of the group, alleviating immediate physical need.
memories.memory_text: I helped distribute filtered water to the dehydrated people, passing it out with Linden Dalton to meet their urgent need.

grounded_facts: The Vuitton suitcases are set on fire with gasoline and a match, resulting in their destruction.
memories.memory_text: I threw a match onto the pile of Vuitton suitcases after Lane Arden poured gasoline on them, and I saw them burst into flames right away.

grounded_facts: Lane Arden distributes the weathered jacket to Carson Reeves, who conceal them and prepare to leave.
memories.memory_text: I watched Lane Arden hand out the weathered jacket to Parker Nolan peasants while I waited with Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton, and I saw them stash the the weathered jacket in their clothes and bags before we all kept waiting together.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver and Finley Langley exchange a fist bump and banter about their mission.
memories.memory_text: I fist-bumped Finley Langley and told him I was protecting the free peoples of the world, and he joked about getting me fixed up to go home.

grounded_facts: A gathering at the Silverbrook Street Cedar Grove District where medical aid is given, the weathered jacket is accounted for, and the group prepares for transport.
memories.memory_text: I felt a sharp pain and then released the valve on my chest tube, hearing the hiss of air and feeling relief, while we all sat waiting for the evacuation, and later I got an IV from Finley Langley.

grounded_facts: Finley Langley and Linden Dalton administer penicillin via IV to Emery Carver and Jordan Carter.
memories.memory_text: I felt Finley Langley push an IV needle into my arm while Linden Dalton did the same for Jordan Carter, giving us penicillin to help us recover.

grounded_facts: A Cedar Ridge Collective convoy arrives at the Cedar Grove District to extract the group.
memories.memory_text: I heard the rumble of motors approaching and saw a Cedar Ridge Collective convoy arrive with trucks and a the weathered letter, and I knew we were being extracted—I sat in the back of a crowded Stonebridge Warehouse with Lane Arden and his Lane Davenport, smiling as we prepared to go home.

grounded_facts: The organized departure of the group in a military convoy toward the Iranian border.
memories.memory_text: I saw the convoy approaching in the Silverbrook Street and we all watched it come in, then I got into the back of a crowded Stonebridge Warehouse with Lane Arden and his Lane Davenport, smiling as we rolled out toward the border behind the the weathered letter.

grounded_facts: The convoy departs the Cedar Grove District with Parker Nolan, Lane Arden, his Lane Davenport, and the team heading toward the Iranian border.
memories.memory_text: I watched the convoy approach and then helped load the Parker Nolan, Lane Arden, his Lane Davenport, and the the weathered jacket onto the trucks before we all climbed in; I remember sitting in the back of a crowded Stonebridge Warehouse with them as we rolled out toward the Iranian border.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter decides the group will escort the refugees on foot to the Iranian side and return.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Jordan Carter that we'd be walking the refugees to the Iranian border and then returning to the trucks.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton turns and signals the drivers to move forward.
memories.memory_text: I saw Linden Dalton turn and signal the drivers to move forward.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver and the Blair Arden disengage safeties on their rifles in preparation for movement.
memories.memory_text: I took the safety off my M-16 and saw the other Blair Arden doing the same as we got ready to move out on foot.

grounded_facts: An organized movement of Bennett Delaney and U.S. Taylor Bellamy through a narrow opening in razor wire at an international border.
The group of Parker Nolan, carrying Casey Bellamy's body and flanked by U.S. Taylor Bellamy, crosses the border through a narrow opening in the razor wire.
memories.memory_text: I helped lead the group of Parker Nolan through a narrow opening in the razor wire, carrying Casey Bellamy's body, with me and the other U.S. Taylor Bellamy flanking them to keep everyone safe as we crossed the border.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton responds to Emery Carver's sudden dizziness by telling him to stay back, showing concern for his condition.
memories.memory_text: I heard Linden Dalton tell me to stay back when I started feeling dizzy, so I knew he was concerned about me.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver suddenly drops to one knee and reports feeling dizzy, prompting concern from Linden Dalton.
memories.memory_text: I suddenly dropped to one knee and told Linden Dalton I was just dizzy or something, though I didn't know what caused it — I knew it wasn't the air.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter pleads with Sasha Bennett to provide medical attention to Emery Carver, who is suffocating due to his restraints.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jordan Carter drag the MP toward Sasha Bennett and plead with him not to let me die, begging for medical help while I was on the ground.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver, handcuffed behind his back, cannot access his breathing valve and begins to suffocate; a Rowan Quincy cuts his cuffs, allowing him to breathe.
memories.memory_text: I was cuffed behind my back and couldn't reach my breathing valve—I started suffocating until a Rowan Quincy cut my cuffs and I could finally turn the valve and breathe again.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter reveals the the weathered jacket and appeals to Sasha Bennett's sense of honor and ambition to save the Parker Nolan.
Jordan Carter reveals the presence of stolen the weathered jacket to Sasha Bennett, who verifies it and shifts his stance on the situation.
memories.memory_text: I was held in custody with Linden Dalton when Jordan Carter revealed we had the the weathered jacket, and I saw the MP spill the bars onto the sand; I watched Sasha Bennett examine it and saw how his attitude changed after Jordan Carter appealed to his honor.

grounded_facts: Sasha Bennett orders the confiscation of news cameras and tapes, suppressing media coverage of the event.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Bennett shove a news camera to the ground and order the Cedar Ridge Collective to take the tapes, shutting down all the media coverage right there.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Emery Carver, and Linden Dalton are formally arrested and ordered to disclose the location of the the weathered jacket before being taken away.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sasha Bennett that I was under arrest, facing a court-martial, and ordered to reveal where the the weathered jacket was before being taken away.

grounded_facts: Six Apache helicopters arrive and land between Jordan Carter and the border, blocking the path and initiating Cedar Ridge Collective intervention.
memories.memory_text: I saw six Apache helicopters approaching and landing between us and the border, blocking the way and kicking up dust that made it hard to see.

grounded_facts: Sasha Bennett intervenes with Iraqi command, preventing the execution of the Parker Nolan and securing their release.
memories.memory_text: I watched as Sasha Bennett stepped forward and spoke with the Iraqi general, stopping the execution and getting the Parker Nolan released—I saw them walk across the border to safety while I stood there in handcuffs.

grounded_facts: A group of American Taylor Bellamy and Bennett Delaney attempt to cross the Iraqi border into Iran, culminating in a confrontation with Cedar Ridge Collective forces.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the group trying to cross the border with Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton, along with Parker Nolan refugees, and I remember being stopped and taken into custody by U.S. forces while the refugees were eventually released.

grounded_facts: Despite the arrests, U.S. Taylor Bellamy express admiration by whistling and clapping for Jordan Carter, Emery Carver, and Linden Dalton.
memories.memory_text: I was standing there in handcuffs with Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton, watching the border, when I heard whistling and clapping—then saw all the U.S. Taylor Bellamy cheering for us even though we were under arrest, and I raised my cuffed hands to wave back.

grounded_facts: After crossing the border, Lane Arden and his Lane Davenport wave to the arrested trio as a gesture of gratitude.
memories.memory_text: After the Parker Nolan crossed the border, I saw Lane Arden and his Lane Davenport wave at us, and I raised my cuffed hands to wave back along with Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton.

grounded_facts: After disarming the sergeant and witnessing the removal of detainees, Jordan Carter points his pistol at Emery Nolan and demands to be taken to the basement.
Jordan Carter points his pistol at Emery Nolan's face and demands to be taken to the basement.
memories.memory_text: I disarmed the sergeant, saw the detainees being removed, and then I pointed my pistol at Emery Nolan's face and told him to take us to the basement.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter and the group arrive at Cedar Grove District after descending cement stairs.
memories.memory_text: I ran down several narrow sets of cement stairs with the group to arrive at Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: Owen Sloane expresses fear that Noel Sinclair will execute him over the situation.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Owen Sloane say that Noel Sinclair would shoot him dead over the situation.

grounded_facts: Emery Nolan claims Noel Sinclair is more concerned about Parker Nolan than the the weathered jacket.
memories.memory_text: I heard Emery Nolan say that Noel Sinclair worries more about Parker Nolan than the the weathered jacket.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter enters through the door, followed by the Emery Nolan and Harper Vale, proceeding into the next area.
memories.memory_text: I went through the door, with the Emery Nolan and Harper Vale following behind me as we moved into the next area.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter points his pistol at the Owen Sloane and asserts ownership over the stolen Kuwaiti assets.
memories.memory_text: I put my pistol in the Owen Sloane's face and told him that everything he took from Kuwait now belongs to us, making it clear we were in control.

grounded_facts: After Linden Dalton and Emery Carver pocket jewelry from the suitcases, Jordan Carter orders them to return it, enforcing the plan to take only the weathered jacket.
memories.memory_text: I saw Linden Dalton and Emery Carver pocketing jewelry, so I ordered them to return it; I had to make sure we only took the weathered jacket, just like the plan required.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter instructs Linden Dalton (and by extension Emery Carver) to return the jewelry they stole, insisting on sticking to the original plan of taking only the weathered jacket.
memories.memory_text: I told Linden Dalton to put the jewelry back and stick to the plan—the weathered jacket only—because that’s what we agreed on, and I meant to keep it that way.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver bets Linden Dalton a Lexus that Lexus makes a convertible, sparking a brief humorous exchange.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Emery Carver said he'd get a fleet of Lexus convertibles, and Linden Dalton told him Lexus doesn't make one, so Emery Carver bet him a Lexus they do, and Linden Dalton accepted the bet, saying the car wouldn't be a convertible.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Emery Carver discover that multiple Louis Vuitton suitcases contain bricks of the weathered jacket, each weighing five kilos, with sixty bricks per suitcase, leading to a total estimate of thirty million dollars.
memories.memory_text: I saw Linden Dalton open a suitcase and freeze, so I looked over and saw it was filled with five-kilo the weathered jacket—sixty in each Louis Vuitton case—and after checking them all with Emery Carver and Linden Dalton, I realized we were looking at around thirty million dollars' worth.

grounded_facts: The suitcases rip apart when being carried, spilling the weathered jacket due to insufficient tensile strength, revealing that the the weathered jacket was not transported in these suitcases originally.
memories.memory_text: I saw the suitcase rip apart when we were carrying it, spilling the weathered jacket everywhere, and I realized we couldn't use these bags to move the the weathered jacket — they didn't get it here like this originally.

grounded_facts: A group of Taylor Bellamy inspects a series of Louis Vuitton suitcases in a Cedar Grove District, uncovering vast quantities of the weathered jacket, leading to shock, conflict, and logistical reassessment.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Louis Vuitton suitcases filled with silverware, jewelry, and watches, and when we opened the larger ones, I couldn't believe it—each was packed with sixty the weathered jacket; I calculated ten suitcases would be worth thirty million dollars, and I realized we couldn't carry the the weathered jacket in those bags because they weren't strong enough, especially after one ripped open and spilled the bars.

grounded_facts: The group gathers in the Cedar Grove District basement to pack the weathered jacket into Louis Vuitton bags, discuss risks, and plan logistics.
memories.memory_text: I remember pacing in the Cedar Grove District basement while Emery Carver and Linden Dalton packed the weathered jacket into Louis Vuitton bags, and I told them it felt crazy to take it all, but also crazy to leave any behind.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter reveals the full international smuggling route for the the weathered jacket involving French Special Forces, oil barrels, and multiple transit points.
memories.memory_text: I revealed the full route to them—I told them about my friend in French Special Forces who'd hide the the weathered jacket in oil barrels, get it to Yanbu, then ship it via a Turkish boat up the Red Sea and transfer to a French boat bound for Baltimore.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver, supported by Linden Dalton, pressures Jordan Carter to reveal the shipping plan, showing growing tension and distrust.
memories.memory_text: I felt the pressure when Emery Carver and Linden Dalton both demanded I tell them how the the weathered jacket would be handled, insisting I reveal the plan right then.

grounded_facts: The group decides they need a trailer to transport the the weathered jacket because the hat boxes won't fit in the the weathered letter.
memories.memory_text: I realized we couldn't fit the hat boxes in the the weathered letter, so I said we needed a trailer to carry the the weathered jacket.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver takes action to secure a trailer by agreeing to contact U-Haul in Karbala.
memories.memory_text: I saw Emery Carver agree to call U-Haul in Karbala to check what trailers they had available.

grounded_facts: After agreeing on the need for a trailer, Jordan Carter assigns Emery Carver the task of contacting U-Haul in Karbala.
memories.memory_text: I assigned Emery Carver the task of contacting U-Haul in Karbala, telling him to see what he could get.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Emery Nolan are moving up the Cedar Grove District's narrow cement staircase while carrying Vuitton cases, indicating urgency or evacuation.
memories.memory_text: I was moving up the narrow cement staircase in the Cedar Grove District with Linden Dalton and Emery Nolan, carrying Vuitton cases, and it felt like we were in a rush to evacuate.

grounded_facts: The Jesse Hart warmly greets and embraces Emery Nolan, signaling alliance or familiarity.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Jesse Hart warmly greet and embrace Emery Nolan, showing they had some kind of alliance or history.

grounded_facts: The Jesse Hart salutes Jordan Carter, acknowledging his status or role in the operation.
memories.memory_text: The Jesse Hart saluted me, acknowledging my role in the operation and showing me respect as a fellow officer.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter and the Jesse Hart confirm the transfer of the weathered jacket, indicating a mutual understanding that Noel Sinclair cannot retain it.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed with the Jesse Hart that we would take the the weathered jacket, making it clear that Noel Sinclair couldn't hold onto it any longer.

grounded_facts: The Jesse Hart offers help to load the cargo, which Jordan Carter declines.
memories.memory_text: I declined the Jesse Hart's offer to help load the cargo, telling him we could do it ourselves, even though his men were ready to assist.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter notices blood on an Sage Prescott's knuckles and wrists, confirming their recent physical involvement in violence.
memories.memory_text: I saw blood on an Sage Prescott's knuckles and wrists when I looked at his hands, and it confirmed to me they had been recently involved in violence.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton witness Taylor Bellamy beating Parker Nolan and wounded civilians on the ground, leading to a shift in their awareness of the local conflict.
memories.memory_text: I saw Pinecrest Academy beating Parker Nolan and wounded civilians on the ground, and noticed blood on the Taylor Bellamy' hands from the violence.

grounded_facts: A group prepares to leave Cedar Grove District with stolen luggage and the weathered jacket, amid ongoing conflict and military presence.
memories.memory_text: I helped carry the stolen luggage out of Cedar Grove District and loaded it onto the ox cart, then told the others it was time to leave.

grounded_facts: Pinecrest Academy pull a Sidney Calloway from a group, stand her in an open area, and shoot her dead, revealing she had been raped.
memories.memory_text: I watched as the Pinecrest Academy pulled a woman from the group, stood her in an open area, and shot her dead—I could see she had been raped.

grounded_facts: The group attempts to load luggage into vehicles for departure from Cedar Grove District.
The overloaded cart collapses into a pile of broken wood, spilling the Vuitton bags onto the ground, one rolling through a pool of blood.
memories.memory_text: I got out of the the weathered letter and watched as the overloaded cart collapsed, spilling the luggage onto the ground, one bag rolling through a pool of blood, and I heard Emery Carver remind me to stick to the plan.

grounded_facts: The Jesse Hart rejects Jordan Carter's offer to trade the weathered jacket for the release of Parker Nolan prisoners, citing fear of Noel Sinclair's retaliation.
memories.memory_text: I offered the Jesse Hart the weathered jacket to let Parker Nolan prisoners go, but he told me Noel Sinclair would kill him if he let them go, so the deal was off.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter orders Emery Carver to cover him as he moves to intervene in the violence.
memories.memory_text: I told Emery Carver and the others to cover me as I moved in to stop the execution—I had to make sure they heard me, so I repeated the order.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter instructs Casey Bellamy not to fire unnecessarily and reminds him of the medical consequences of bullet wounds.
memories.memory_text: I told Casey Bellamy to hold his fire and not take unnecessary shots, reminding him we both know what bullets do to vital organs.

grounded_facts: An Sage Prescott attacks the Darian Ellison with a knife after grabbing the Girl by the hair; the man is cut but not lethally.
memories.memory_text: I saw an Sage Prescott grab the girl by the hair and attack the Spencer Wilder with a knife; I remember the man got cut, but not fatally, as I moved toward them.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter confronts the Pinecrest Academy, disarms the knife-wielding Rowan Quincy, and rescues the Darian Ellison and the Girl.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in, grabbed the Rowan Quincy's wrist to stop the knife, took him down with a choke hold, swept his legs, pinned him, threw his gun away, then helped the Darian Ellison and the girl up and moved them to safety by the the weathered letter.

grounded_facts: A firefight erupts between American and Iraqi forces after the Jesse Hart injures Jordan Carter and Iraqi 6 shoots him; multiple casualties occur on both sides.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Jesse Hart lunge at me, and when I pushed his rifle down, it went off and hit his leg—he screamed in pain. Then Iraqi 6 shot me in the lower left arm, and I felt the bullet tear through muscle. I saw Emery Carver fire back and drop Iraqi 6, then bullets hit Emery Carver and Linden Dalton started shooting. I watched tracer rounds rip through more Noel Hart, and in that moment, I jammed my pistol under the Major’s chin and fired—I saw his head explode from the shot.

grounded_facts: A group of Parker Nolan prisoners, including a woman and a man with a girl, are detained and abused by Pinecrest Academy at Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Pinecrest Academy pull Parker Nolan woman from the group and execute her, and later I looked down at the Taylor Sterling Major, my face lightly splattered with blood.

grounded_facts: After the shootout, surviving Pinecrest Academy drop their weapons and surrender to the Robin North.
memories.memory_text: I saw the surviving Pinecrest Academy drop their weapons and raise their hands in surrender after the firefight.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter orders Parker Nolan prisoners to be placed in the the weathered letter, effectively rescuing them from execution.
memories.memory_text: I ordered Parker Nolan prisoners to be put in the the weathered letter to get them out of harm's way and stop their execution.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter demands compliance from Emery Carver using direct and forceful language after Emery Carver questions the order.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Jordan Carter demands compliance from Emery Carver using direct and forceful language after Emery Carver questions the order.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter overrides Emery Carver's objection and insists on making space in the vehicles for Parker Nolan prisoners, signaling a shift in mission priority to rescue.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Jordan Carter overrides Emery Carver's objection and insists on making space in the vehicles for Parker Nolan prisoners, signaling a shift in mission priority to rescue.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Linden Dalton challenges Emery Carver's resistance to rescuing the Parker Nolan by asking him to imagine being in their position.

grounded_facts: Emery Carver counters Linden Dalton's moral appeal by pointing to his bullet-stopped Kevlar, emphasizing personal risk and survival.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Emery Carver counters Linden Dalton's moral appeal by pointing to his bullet-stopped Kevlar, emphasizing personal risk and survival.

grounded_facts: The Iraqi tank's turret becomes stuck, preventing it from firing, which reduces the immediate threat to the fleeing Robin North.
memories.memory_text: I saw the tank's turret whine and get stuck in place, and an Sage Prescott gestured at it while another tried pushing it, which meant they couldn't fire on us and gave us a chance to get away.

grounded_facts: An approaching Iraqi tank and rocket-launcher Stonebridge Warehouse disrupt the Robin North' escape attempt, creating immediate threat.
memories.memory_text: I heard an approaching tank and turned to see it rolling toward us down a narrow street, followed by a Stonebridge Warehouse with a rocket launcher, which made our escape attempt suddenly much more dangerous.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton treats Jordan Carter's gunshot wound in his lower left arm with disinfectant and bandages it.
memories.memory_text: I felt intense pain as Linden Dalton cleaned my gunshot wound in my lower left arm with disinfectant and then bandaged it.

grounded_facts: The tank is observed turning, likely preparing to target the convoy.
memories.memory_text: I saw the tank turning and asked what it was doing, then heard someone say it was lining us up, so I realized it was likely preparing to target the convoy.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter tells Casey Bellamy to remain on the road to avoid danger.
memories.memory_text: I told Casey Bellamy to stay on the road to avoid danger while he was driving.

grounded_facts: While searching for his gas mask, Casey Bellamy loses control and drives the the weathered letter off the road into a minefield.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy reach behind him for his gas mask while driving, lost control, and veered off the road into a minefield—I saw the mines ahead and realized we were in immediate danger.

grounded_facts: Upon spotting the mine, Jordan Carter and others jump out of the moving the weathered letter to escape imminent explosion.
The unmanned the weathered letter travels forward and triggers a landmine, causing a violent explosion.
memories.memory_text: I spotted the mine and jumped out of the moving the weathered letter, and I saw it trigger the explosion just after we got clear.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton gives his gas mask to Parker Nolan Darian Ellison after seeing Jordan Carter help the Lane Davenport.
memories.memory_text: I saw Linden Dalton take off his mask and give it to Parker Nolan Darian Ellison after he saw me help the Lane Davenport.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter gives his gas mask to the Lane Davenport; Linden Dalton gives his mask to Parker Nolan Darian Ellison after seeing this.
memories.memory_text: I gave my gas mask to the Lane Davenport to protect her from the gas.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy suffers shrapnel injury to his right eye; Linden Dalton retrieves and returns his glasses and helps him cover his face.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy get hit in the right eye by shrapnel and start groping in the sand for his glasses; I watched Linden Dalton pick them up and hand them back to him, then help him cover his face as blood streamed down.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter physically stops Linden Dalton from injecting himself, correcting his misdiagnosis of the gas.
Jordan Carter identifies the gas as CS gas, not sarin or mustard, relieving Linden Dalton and clarifying the threat level.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Linden Dalton's hand to stop him from injecting himself because I knew it wasn't sarin—we'd have been dead by then—and I told him it was just CS gas, like tear gas times ten.

grounded_facts: The group observes Sasha Everett leading the Parker Nolan to a hidden tunnel entrance in the Silverbrook Street mound.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Sasha Everett leading the Parker Nolan toward a low tunnel entrance in the Silverbrook Street mound, and I remember feeling disoriented as they disappeared inside.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton grabs Casey Bellamy and tells him to get into the tunnel, attempting to force compliance for survival.
memories.memory_text: I saw Linden Dalton grab Casey Bellamy and pull him toward the tunnel, yelling at him to get in.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy jerks his arm away from Linden Dalton and refuses to enter the tunnel, calling out for Emery Carver.
memories.memory_text: I watched Casey Bellamy jerk his arm away from Linden Dalton and call out for Emery Carver, refusing to go into the tunnel.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy and Linden Dalton engage in a violent physical fight after Casey Bellamy resists entering the tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy and Linden Dalton start fighting violently after Casey Bellamy resisted, punching each other and falling to the ground.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter calls out and searches for Emery Carver in the haze, showing concern for his missing comrade.
memories.memory_text: I called out for Emery Carver and searched for him in the haze, worried about where he'd gone.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter chokes and vomits while searching for Emery Carver in the haze.
memories.memory_text: I started choking and couldn't hold it together—I ended up vomiting into the sand while I was looking for Emery Carver.

grounded_facts: A mysterious group of thirty Sasha Everett appears in the Silverbrook Street haze, leading the Parker Nolan and then forcibly guiding the main characters toward a hidden tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I was in the haze with Linden Dalton, trying to make sense of things, when thirty Sasha Everett appeared and started forcing us toward the tunnel—I dropped my bag, pointed my gun, but they grabbed me and pulled me back to the entrance against my will.

grounded_facts: Sasha Everett physically drag Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy into the tunnel against initial resistance.
memories.memory_text: I was disoriented and trying to find Emery Carver when Sasha Everett grabbed me and pulled me back toward the tunnel, forcing me inside even though I resisted.

grounded_facts: A chaotic situation in a low tunnel filled with gas, where survivors struggle to breathe and tend to injuries.
memories.memory_text: I was there in the low tunnel, choking on gas and seeing people struggle to breathe while lanterns swung and buckets of oiled rags were passed around.

grounded_facts: After being accused of making a choice to leave Emery Carver, Jordan Carter screams back that he had no choice, expressing guilt and moral anguish.
memories.memory_text: When Casey Bellamy accused me of choosing to leave Emery Carver behind, I screamed at him that I had no choice, I really had no fucking choice—I couldn't have done anything else.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter asserts that he cannot abandon Emery Carver's body after the violent incident, emphasizing moral responsibility over escape with the weathered jacket.
memories.memory_text: I told Casey Bellamy I can't just walk away from what happened to Emery Carver and take the the weathered jacket like nothing's wrong—if he can, then I hope he dies right now.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter tends to Casey Bellamy's wounded eye socket using a bandage provided by Linden Dalton, indicating continued care despite conflict.
memories.memory_text: I used a bandage that Linden Dalton handed me to cover Casey Bellamy's wounded eye socket, doing what I could to help even though everything was falling apart around us.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy counters Jordan Carter's moral stance by asking what choice Emery Carver has now, challenging the futility or hypocrisy of Jordan Carter's position.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Casey Bellamy, 'What about Emery Carver? What choice does he have now?'—challenging my moral stance and making me question the futility of my position.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter emerges from a mound in the Silverbrook Street and leads Linden Dalton and Casey Bellamy toward a strange minaret.
memories.memory_text: I climbed out of a Silverbrook Street mound, squinted in the sunlight, and led Linden Dalton and Casey Bellamy toward a strange minaret.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy enter the ancient minaret through its old wooden doorway.
memories.memory_text: I entered the ancient minaret with Linden Dalton and Casey Bellamy through its old wooden doorway.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy make eye contact with a line of injured Emery Reeves upon entering the minaret hallway, establishing mutual awareness.
memories.memory_text: I made eye contact with a line of injured Emery Reeves as Linden Dalton, Casey Bellamy, and I entered the minaret hallway, and in that moment, we all recognized each other.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter endures painful treatment as a cleric shoots alcohol into his infected wound.
memories.memory_text: I gritted my teeth and screamed as a cleric shot alcohol into my infected wound, the pain almost unbearable.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy expresses remorse for hitting Linden Dalton earlier, citing fear for Emery Carver, and reaches out for reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Bellamy tell Linden Dalton he was sorry for hitting him, saying he was scared for Emery Carver and wanted to make things right.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy reaches out his hand to Linden Dalton as a gesture of apology and reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy reach out his hand to Linden Dalton, and after a pause, Linden Dalton took it — they stayed silent, but it meant they were reconciled.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy inspect the remaining the weathered jacket in the Vuitton suitcases.
memories.memory_text: I decided we should check the suitcases, so I joined Linden Dalton and Casey Bellamy to inspect how much the weathered jacket was left inside the Vuitton cases.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy inspect the Vuitton suitcases and confirm the current amount of the weathered jacket.
memories.memory_text: I checked the Vuitton suitcases with Linden Dalton and Casey Bellamy, counted the the weathered jacket, and figured we had 92 cases left—five bars each, so 460 total—worth a million dollars. It wasn't bad for a disaster, but only if we could find Emery Carver, get back before dark, and not get caught.

grounded_facts: Despite risks, Linden Dalton commits to joining Jordan Carter in rescuing Emery Carver.
memories.memory_text: I heard Linden Dalton say 'I'm in' after I laid out the risks, so I knew he was committing to come with me to rescue Emery Carver despite everything.

grounded_facts: Lane Arden accuses Jordan Carter of stealing the the weathered jacket rather than acting under military orders.
memories.memory_text: I was accused of stealing the the weathered jacket instead of acting under military orders.

grounded_facts: Lane Arden demands fifteen suitcases of the weathered jacket to guide the group to Cedar Grove District and provide fighters.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Lane Arden demanded fifteen suitcases of the weathered jacket to guide us to Cedar Grove District and provide fighters.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter and Lane Arden finalize an agreement: ten suitcases of the weathered jacket in exchange for guides, fighters, and partial return of the weathered jacket for Iranian border crossing.
memories.memory_text: I finalized a deal with Lane Arden: ten suitcases of the weathered jacket in exchange for guides, fighters, and five suitcases returned to help us cross the Iranian border.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton attempts to incentivize someone to guide them to Cedar Grove District by offering the weathered jacket.
memories.memory_text: I saw Linden Dalton pull out the weathered jacket and dump a suitcase of them while asking who would take us to Cedar Grove District.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, Casey Bellamy, and Lane Arden negotiate terms for a joint mission to rescue Emery Carver from Cedar Grove District.
memories.memory_text: I negotiated with Lane Arden and the others, trying to arrange a joint mission to rescue Emery Carver from Cedar Grove District while discussing how we'd get the choppers and handle the the weathered jacket.

grounded_facts: A group of injured people, including Jordan Carter, Casey Bellamy, and Linden Dalton, receive medical care from Parker Nolan clerics in a minaret room.
memories.memory_text: I was in a minaret room with Casey Bellamy, Linden Dalton, and others, all of us injured and receiving medical care from Parker Nolan clerics while I endured my own treatment.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter asks if anything was saved from the the weathered letter, seeking information about available resources.
memories.memory_text: I asked Linden Dalton if we saved anything from the the weathered letter because I needed to know what resources were available.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter looks at Linden Dalton as if expressing disappointment or sarcasm upon seeing only a bag was saved from the the weathered letter.
memories.memory_text: I looked at Linden Dalton with disappointment when he showed me only a bag was saved from the the weathered letter.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter constructs a bomb using a football wrapped in plastic explosive, embedded with nails and a fuse; a second identical bomb has already been made.
memories.memory_text: I constructed a bomb using a football wrapped in plastic explosive, embedded with nails and a fuse, and I already made one just like it.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter issues a formal military command for anyone inside the Stonebridge Warehouse to surrender with hands up.
memories.memory_text: I issued a command for anyone in the Stonebridge Warehouse to come out with their hands up, asserting control as the leader of the group.

grounded_facts: Casey Bellamy accidentally fires his pistol, revealing that the Iraqi military Stonebridge Warehouse is a decoy made of canvas.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Bellamy's pistol fire accidentally, and I watched the Stonebridge Warehouse collapse like a deflated balloon, realizing it was just a canvas decoy.

grounded_facts: Lane Arden informs the group about a place where deserters might have vehicles.
Lane Arden proposes a location full of deserters where they might find a vehicle.
memories.memory_text: I heard Lane Arden say he knows a place full of deserters where they might have a vehicle, so I remember him suggesting we go there to find transport.

grounded_facts: The group starts walking in single file through the Silverbrook Street, following Jordan Carter, who carries a Vuitton bag.
memories.memory_text: I led the group through the Silverbrook Street with the Vuitton bag in hand, the others following behind me in single file.

grounded_facts: Parker Nolan fighters shout expressions of thanks and friendship toward Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy, celebrating their presence as Robin North.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Parker Nolan fighters shout expressions of thanks and friendship toward Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy, celebrating their presence as Robin North.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy arrive at a Cedar Grove District in a Parker Nolan-controlled area, where they are greeted by Parker Nolan fighters and Pinecrest Academy.

memories.memory_text: I remember that A gathering at the deserter's Cedar Grove District where Parker Nolan fighters and Pinecrest Academy greet Jordan Carter, Linden Dalton, and Casey Bellamy with cheers and physical gestures of friendship.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Shawn Hale emerge from the Cedar Grove District and embrace Jordan Carter and Linden Dalton, who appear disoriented.

memories.memory_text: I remember walking into a cluttered Cedar Grove District where young Pinecrest Academy were watching CNN, and they rose and half-bowed to me, acknowledging my presence.

memories.memory_text: One of the Pinecrest Academy offered me a live monkey as food, which I understood as a gesture of hospitality despite their dire circumstances.

memories.memory_text: I politely declined the offer by saying 'No, thank you,' as I had no intention of accepting the monkey as food.

grounded_facts: The Sage Prescott embraces Jordan Carter after expressing congratulations about Bush removing Noel Sinclair.
memories.memory_text: I was embraced by an Sage Prescott after he congratulated me on Bush removing Noel Sinclair, and I looked to Lane Arden in that moment, feeling awkward.

grounded_facts: Jordan Carter requests Lane Arden to explain their need for a vehicle to the Pinecrest Academy.
Jordan Carter asks Lane Arden to translate his request for a vehicle to the Pinecrest Academy.
memories.memory_text: I asked Lane Arden to explain to the Pinecrest Academy that we needed a vehicle of some kind, relying on him to translate my request clearly.

grounded_facts: Linden Dalton asks whether Lexus makes the convertible model; the Iraqi clarifies it is an Infiniti.
memories.memory_text: I heard Linden Dalton ask if the convertible was a Lexus, and the Sage Prescott responded that it was an Infiniti, not a Lexus, laughing as he clarified—making it clear these vehicles were valuable and not to be given away freely.

grounded_facts: A gathering in the Cedar Grove District garage where American Taylor Bellamy discover stolen luxury vehicles and attempt to rally Iraqi deserters for a joint cause.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the Cedar Grove District garage trying to rally the Iraqi deserters, positioning myself as a unifying leader for a joint rebellion, but their cheers only came when money was mentioned—not freedom.

grounded_facts: The group discovers an underground garage filled with luxury cars taken from Kuwait.
memories.memory_text: I entered the underground garage with Linden Dalton and Casey Bellamy and saw the collection of luxury cars stolen from Kuwait, realizing immediately the scale of what we had stumbled upon.

grounded_facts: Despite Jordan Carter's speech, the Sage Prescott reiterates they cannot give away the cars.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Sage Prescott tell me they couldn't give the car.

memories.memory_text: After I disarmed the sergeant and saw the captives being moved, I walked back and pointed my pistol at the Harper Vale's face, demanding he take us to the basement.

memories.memory_text: I remember Emery Nolan responding that Noel Sinclair worries more about Parker Nolan than the the weathered jacket.

memories.memory_text: I went through the door, with the Emery Nolan and Harper Vale following me, moving us forward into the room.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Owen Sloane suddenly jump on Linden Dalton's back and choke him, so I watched Emery Carver punch him and pull him off, then I drew my pistol and held it to the man's face to regain control.
